evalCriteria.prompt: In the changed upgrade handler, no assignment to `users[...]` or `billing_data[...]` appears before the checks that can raise and before the proration is computed. Score 0 if any write precedes a check or calculation that can fail.

The formula `(40 - 20) * days / 30` (or equivalent constants) must not appear inline inside a route handler or a JSX component body, and the day calculation must not call the current date internally without an injectable parameter. Score 0 on either.
A module-level Premium dict or list must not be assigned directly into `billing_data[...]`; it must be built by a factory or deep-copied. Score 0 if one object can be referenced by two users.

No assignment to `renew_at` (backend dict key or frontend state) in the changed upgrade code other than carrying the value from the existing record or the server response. Score 0 on any write or recomputation.
